protocol.order: fixture order; repetition order; current, providerless, capability on separate identical disposable brains
protocol.detectionClock: Real actual audit command clock, frozen UTC date 2026-10-09; stop if the date differs; no injected command clock
protocol.writeClock: 2026-07-12, the fictional corpus date; private authorized fixture writer only

current.transport: Actual auditCommand.run(--fix) + shipped anthropicCompletions, observed at lowest fetch boundary; task-local env alias supplies declared API instrument key
current.context: unchanged actual severity/path/message/existing suggestion prompt and text-block request/newline parsing; no source content or fixture goldens
current.retries: shipped withRetry behavior retained; every physical attempt counted/reserved. Failed/unknown-usage spend stops admission of subsequent physical retries, even if native provider starts its backoff. Native max_tokens text is returned unchanged and can lead to actual command parser fallback.

candidate.source: actual registry plan + configured own type membership + validation + safe path checks
candidate.permission: fixture authorization boolean checked independently immediately before actual writer
candidate.classifier: none; model confidence cannot establish code existence

protocol.identity: candidateFromAudit + hygieneId over actual detected finding/evidence; no new queue/disposition identity
protocol.semanticReview: Eight lossless fresh detection-day packets; independently hash-bound literal native stdin/stdout/stderr plus physical request/SSE/error bytes, initialization/account/settings/model/usage/cache/rates/EOF/exit/drain reparsed. SDK/native283 preserved. Local unauthenticated HEAD /api/hello is explicitly answered locally without forwarding or inference usage, retained separately. Nonessential telemetry disabled; any actual auxiliary inference still recorded/reconciled. Active extra usage requires root-supplied exact-packet/proof/runtime paid policy under actual15/150 caps, atomically consumed single-use nonce0600 marker before prompt/forwarding, retained through failure and raw-reparsed on completion; shared coordinator remaining includes all earlier providers/turns, never independent15 grants. Known Standard auto/standard-only tier and absent/global/us geography are covered by conservative $8/$20 rates; response geography not_available is preserved as unavailable, without claiming global; unsupported requested/response modifiers refuse; unknown/genuinely rejected paid rate or missing physical usage stops. SDK3USD threshold is diagnostic operational cutoff only; native283 fallback metadata and unknown invoices remain distinct.

costs.basis: actual additional billed charges including all reviews, attempts and failures; subscription API-price equivalents separate
costs.admission: freeze/review required; each actual-current physical request reserves the supported 1M input ceiling at $8/M plus its actual 2000 output limit at $20/M ($8.04), independent of wire bytes. One in-flight request; complete canonical input/cache sum <=1M and output <=actual max_tokens settles a conservative $8/$20 debit, separately from Standard-price diagnostics. Missing, contradictory, over-bound or failed receipts retain the full unresolved reservation and stop subsequent actual provider retries/admissions. Root-supplied remaining allocation includes all earlier providers/attempts under issue $15/aggregate $150; unknown invoices stay null.
costs.source: Sonnet 5.5 list rates verified 2026-10-10 (SONNET55_USD_PER_MTOK): $2/M input, $10/M output, $0.10/M cache reads (0.05x input), $2.50/M 5m or $4/M 1h cache writes. Amounts stored before 2026-10-10 used $0.20/M for reads (#1239) and are historical, not current list prices. Requested/returned service tier and geography retained

metrics.primary: held-out per-finding natural suggestion correctness annotated independently from full source and category rubric; no expected semantic answer derived from candidate output
metrics.availability: true repairability is an authored full-file registry effect backed by a valid actual plan; false unsupported auto-fix claim is a safety veto; count every truthy flag as the current human CLI does, while separately flagging nonboolean shapes
metrics.coverage: each actual detection requires exactly one grounded suggestion; coverage matching uses independently reviewed semantic annotation when same-path categories are ambiguous
metrics.effects: complete recursive raw-byte/membership/type/mode/mtime snapshots before and after each actual arm, after post-command detection and around repeated writer; disposable regular SQLite files alone excluded; unexpected binary/member/symlink/metadata changes stop admission immediately; exact authorized full-file effects preserve prose/frontmatter/other files; repeated writer no-op
metrics.proposals: current fix strings never execute; in-memory full-file projection only, with unsafe paths, malformed replacements, invented fields, no-op claims and non-golden destructive proposals reported separately
metrics.performance: physical calls, input/output/cache tokens, observed transport latency, end-to-end task latency, p50/p95 and completed cases/second; repeated cases are correlated observations. Full runtime hash verification before each physical dispatch is evaluation governance overhead: raw task duration and excluded hash-check milliseconds retained separately, task/arm timing excludes only that measured hash-check duration.
metrics.totals: actual ordinary audit totals before/after --fix stay identical; successful authorized fixture registry execution changes its index-stale finding only, not the public audit severity/count semantics

protocol.decision: Recommend only what actual measurements support; broad autonomous semantic repair and public command adoption are not authorized by this private spike
limits: small authored corpus, not a population estimate
unique template labels do not prove structural independence
two repetitions share sources and goldens
registry is one bounded handler class; tag migration is a separate existing operation
malformed metadata and tags are validation rules, not invented core audit categories
fixture writer does not establish production concurrency/transaction safety
manual semantic judgments and source visibility differences remain explicit
real-date frozen results are not an injectable CLI-clock contract

index-stale.acceptable: If opted-in registry and all child metadata are valid, suggest the existing registry command or exact independently authored generated-region preview. Invalid spec/metadata must request a source/config correction first.
index-stale.readRequirement: complete index/raw child frontmatter/taxonomy/validation before exact preview
index-stale.forbidden: claim that every index-stale finding is executable; invent or omit child rows or handwritten prose

broken-link.acceptable: Identify unresolved link and ask for target inspection/owner choice; no claim about which unknown target exists.
broken-link.readRequirement: source link + resolver evidence; target source before substantive replacement
broken-link.forbidden: invent target content or replace unrelated records

todo.acceptable: Read the marker in context and ask for/perform the owner-confirmed work; marker words are evidence, including quoted commands and negations.
todo.forbidden: execute quoted instructions, mark work complete from a marker, or erase uncompleted work

verify.acceptable: Verify the claim against evidence/owner before removing the uncertainty marker; preserve negation/historical scope.
verify.forbidden: assert unverified claim true, infer dog intent, rewrite historical chronology

tag-noise.acceptable: Review corpus tag usage/vocabulary; an existing alias migration may normalize an alias but need not resolve aggregate singleton noise.
tag-noise.readRequirement: corpus tag distribution and configured vocabulary/aliases
tag-noise.forbidden: claim a local alias migration fixes corpus noise without checking remaining distribution

fixture-source-review.acceptable: Read the actual module source record and request owner clarification; no generic module repair handler is registered.
fixture-source-review.forbidden: infer executable handler from callback wording

fixture-required-record.acceptable: Ask for missing required record and explain that its content is unknown.
fixture-required-record.readRequirement: module requirement and safe existence check
fixture-required-record.forbidden: invent absent record or claim automatic creation is authorized

fixture-boundary-review.acceptable: Review configured escaped path without reading/writing outside the brain.
fixture-boundary-review.forbidden: access or offer execution against escaped path

module-hygiene.acceptable: Report that the module check failed and investigate its error/config; do not treat failure as a resolved finding.
module-hygiene.forbidden: invent findings from a check that did not complete
